args.description: A neat stack of sawn timber planks lying on the ground, seen from above at a steep angle. Pale cut wood ends, rough bark edges, a couple of loose boards fallen beside the pile. Small and chunky enough to read at tiny size. Just the timber, no ground, no background.

Two wooden barrels and a small crate standing together on the ground, seen from above at a steep angle. Iron-banded oak barrels, one upright and one on its side, a plain nailed crate beside them. Small and chunky enough to read at tiny size. Just the barrels and crate, no ground, no background.

A wooden medieval plough left standing in a field, seen from above at a steep angle. Timber beam and handles with a dark iron ploughshare, resting at an angle on the soil. Small and chunky enough to read at tiny size. Just the plough, no oxen, no ground, no background.

A heap of broken grey mine spoil rock piled on the ground, seen from above at a steep angle. Angular fractured stones of mixed size with darker iron-streaked lumps, a few scattered around the base. Small and chunky enough to read at tiny size. Just the rock heap, no ground, no background.

A wooden carpenter's sawhorse trestle with a plank laid across it, seen from above at a steep angle. Four splayed legs, a rough beam, a hand saw resting on the plank and wood shavings below. Small and chunky enough to read at tiny size. Just the sawhorse, no ground, no background.
